Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed page). Main file: every MATTER datasheet (Tables 8-11 steam cracking of ethane/LPG/naphtha/gas oil, 14 FCC off-gas olefin recovery, 17 oxidative coupling, 19 MTO, 21 biomass flash pyrolysis, 25-27 PE, 29 PP, 31 benzene, 32 styrene, 33 PS, 35 VCM, 36 PVC, 38 PET, 40 ABS, 43 PUR, 45 SBR, 53-54 mixed plastic waste, 55 mechanical recycling, 56 bitumen/lubricants) with electricity, fuel, steam, gas and oil per t product, CO2, investment, fixed and variable O&M, lifetime and availability; plastics processing electricity/gas (Table 47) and mean costs (Table 48); cracker literature energy values (p.13). Datasheet columns are 2000 and 2020; a 2020 process is written only where a value differs. Costs are ECU 1994 (stated), per t annual product capacity; the general method (p.7) adds off-sites at 40% of battery limits where missing and sets fixed O&M at 4% of investment where unknown, so COST BASIS is recorded as total-plant; many costs are the author's estimates or proxies (PS, SBR, PP, synthetic lubricants copied from PE). All energy in LHV (stated p.8). Steam cracker 'fuel' is the energy requirement from the balance tables (Tables 4-7), fired with the process's own by-product fuels; feedstock GJ and surplus fuels are in _flows. Mixed plastic waste costs are per-t processing costs (cost-levelized) because the source gives no investment; electricity there includes 1.9 GJe/t preparation (formula). Not loaded: Table 49 'enhanced' plastics processing and gas-turbine integration (in _measures), residual capacities, market statistics, product yield tables, Table 57 sector CO2 totals and incineration factors (in _other-values selectively). Traps: MTO investment printed as 'ECU1940' (typo for ECU1994); MTO 1.1 GJ steam may overlap the 12.3 GJ energy requirement; Table 49 thermoforming gas 5.0 GJ/t enhanced although Table 47 standard has no gas; PS 2.4 GJ/t in text vs datasheet 2.42 sum; OCM datasheet columns 2000/2010. New commodity terms used in flows: c4-fraction, styrene, regranulate, vacuum-residue, bitumen. Region: Western Europe (Netherlands/Germany data), 1994 prices.
